title: RBI Discontinues Countercyclical Capital Buffer (CCyB) Activation for FY27
summary: RBI review concludes prevailing economic conditions do not warrant CCyB activation, keeping buffer requirement at 0%.

blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 RBI Discontinues Countercyclical Capital Buffer (CCyB) Activation for FY27. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: RBI decided against activating the Countercyclical Capital Buffer (CCyB) under commercial bank capital adequacy norms, citing stable credit-to-GDP gap trends.
